prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas of EIGHT original medieval dark fantasy environment props for a 2D side-scrolling ARPG. Strict 4 columns by 2 rows equal square cells, one isolated fully contained prop per cell, generous transparent gutters. Same realistic painterly pre-rendered 2.5D look as a grim gothic RPG, low side-view camera, realistic weathered wood/stone/iron, muted charcoal and brown with warm firelight. Row1: broken wooden supply cart with sacks; stone brazier with a small amber fire; mossy ruined shrine with two candles; gnarled leafless dead tree. Row2: stack of battered barrels and open wooden crate; cracked gravestones with ivy; cluster of jagged mossy rocks and ferns; small abandoned adventurer canvas tent with rolled blankets and unlit campfire ring. No people, no creatures, no background, no ground plane, no UI, no text, no borders, no watermark. Every prop entirely inside its own cell. NOT flat vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low poly.
